Package org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic

Class AgenticTurnTrigger

java.lang.Object
org.cibseven.connect.ai.agent.agentic.AgenticTurnTrigger
All Implemented Interfaces:
AdHocSubProcessObserver
public class AgenticTurnTrigger extends Object implements AdHocSubProcessObserver
Records what a child of an agentic scope produced as it ends, and gives the scope a further turn when one of its children has ended or has been removed.

The record is taken here, in the one moment the child's declared variables still hold what this performance produced, and kept on the agent state (CIB7-2147): not through the scope's outputCollection, which belongs to the modeller, and not in a process variable, which every tool and every other agent in the process could read and rewrite.

Told by the scope's own behaviour, not by an END listener on each child. The listener missed three cases (CIB7-2140): a tool with asyncAfter, whose END fires before its continuation, while the turn that started it is still running, so nothing was scheduled when it really ended; a nested ad hoc scope as a tool, whose end the listener attributed to the inner scope; and skipCustomListeners, which skips any listener. The behaviour reports a child once, when its execution leaves the scope, which is also the end of a chain.

Runs in the child's transaction and does no more than insert a job row, so completing a user task waits for an INSERT rather than for a language model.
